definitions.explanation: The quality that makes something interesting or appealing; an attractive or engaging character.

examples.japanese: {興趣|きょうしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だった。
⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{興趣|きょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were encounters that added charm to the journey.

examples.japanese: {興趣|きょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じさせる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧だった。
examples.english: It was an exhibition that evoked interest.

notes:
{興趣|きょうしゅ} describes the quality of being interesting or appealing.

FORMS:
- {興|きょう} (interest, excitement) + {趣|しゅ} (charm, taste)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {興趣|きょうしゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: to be rich in interest
- {興趣|きょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to add flavor/interest
- {興趣|きょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel interest/charm
- {興趣|きょうしゅ}{深|ぶか}い: deeply interesting

USAGE:
{興趣|きょうしゅ} is a literary/formal word. In everyday speech, ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧ or ⟦{興味深|きょうみぶか}い→興味深い：20118_kyoumibukai⟧ are more common.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{趣|おもむき}→趣：09072_omomuki⟧: charm, flavor
- ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧: hobby, interest
- ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧: interest (more common)
